svg.aria-label: What runs where. wsl-shrinker.exe, the Windows program, reads the disks and runs every shrink. A Windows terminal sends it keys and shows its screen; in a WSL terminal, the Linux build draws the screen and asks the .exe as JSON lines. It asks wsl.exe, compacts other disks through Windows' virtual disk API, and reads the disk files without mounting them.
